card.line: Aphek was the name of several towns in Bible lands, and one city was a battlefield where Israel faced the Philistines and the Arameans.

moments.title: Philistines camp at Aphek
moments.text: The Israelites camped at Ebenezer while the Philistines camped at Aphek. Israel was defeated, and about four thousand men were struck down.

moments.title: Philistines gather forces
moments.text: The Philistines brought all their forces together at Aphek. The Philistine commanders did not trust David, so Achish sent him back in peace.

moments.title: Victory over the Arameans
moments.text: Ben-hadad led the Arameans to Aphek to fight Israel. The LORD gave Israel the victory, and a wall fell on twenty-seven thousand of the men who fled into the city.

moments.title: Elisha's arrow of victory
moments.text: Elisha told the king of Israel to shoot an arrow from the east window. He said it was the LORD's arrow of victory, and Israel would strike the Arameans in Aphek.
